title: Ten Winters and One Short Ladder
subtitle: 科学研究 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学研究（人与社会·科学与技术）
meta: 主题语境：科学研究（人与社会·科学与技术）　|　核心词汇：engineer　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 engineer 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my father ① took on an engineer that no worker on the site would have trusted, and he said the taking on was the whole of the winter. The ② engineer, meaning the man himself and not the crew, ran ten winters and stayed untrusted in the book; an engineer, he said, is the only thing on a site that is judged by how long it is left untrusted.

Every ③ engineer on that site had the same short ladder beside him, and the ④ engineer at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the bridge and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An engineer, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to trust; my father said the trusting is the part that fills ten winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the engineer was the whole of the machine, meaning the mind behind it and not the man. The ⑥ engineer, meaning the mind and not any of that, is the only thing in a machine that everybody waits for and nobody trusts; engineer, he said, is either somebody you take on or the only word that means both a man and a mind. He said the mind is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ engineer had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short ladder. The ⑧ engineer of the whole thing, my father wrote in January, was one site and ten winters of trusting; engineer, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to trust. He said the trusting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ engineer I remember is the one trusted in the register, which closed in 1964 and is still described as the quietest on the site. An ⑩ engineer, my mother said in 1966, is the only one that improves by being trusted; every engineer, she said, is a mind that has agreed to look like a man. She said the mind was the honest half.

answers.why: take on an engineer 意为“聘请一位工程师”，1953 年父亲聘请了一位工地上没有一位工人肯信赖的工程师。
engineer 意为“工程师”，指那个人本身而不是工人，他经过了十个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
engineer 意为“工程师”，指工地上每一位身边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一架短短的梯子。
engineer 意为“工程师”，指留给大桥的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
engineer 意为“设计师、筹划者”，指机器里人人都等却无人信赖的那样东西，叔叔说这位筹划者就是那台机器的全部。
engineer 意为“头脑、策划”，指人人都需要却无人信赖的那种力量而不是那个人，是机器里人人都等、却无人信赖的东西。
engineer 意为“工程师”，指名册上写到、被登记的那一位，到 1959 年这一位成了名册里的一行。
engineer 意为“工程师”，父亲一月写道，整件事的头脑之事是一个工地和十个冬天的信赖。
engineer 意为“工程师”，我记得的是名册上登记的那一位，1964 年结束了，至今仍被说成工地上最安静的一位。
engineer 为抽象总称，母亲 1966 年说，一位工程师是唯一会因为被好好信赖而变得更好的东西。
